preview_heading: The CPL 2026 title will be decided in Bridgetown
preview: The winners of Qualifier 1 and Qualifier 2 meet under the lights at Kensington Oval for the CPL 2026 championship. The confirmed finalists will appear here once the playoff results are known.
preview_detail: Team names, confirmed squads and playing XIs will update after qualification is settled. No participant is listed before the relevant result is official.
